notes.title: Razaak Has Risen!
notes.content:
[p]An ancient evil stirs once more… and it’s waiting for YOU in the deepest, darkest dungeon of Allansia...[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3855210/Crypt_of_the_Sorcerer_Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/"][/dynamiclink]That’s right, adventurers. [b]Crypt of the Sorcerer[/b] is now LIVE in the [b]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/b] library![/p][p]Written by [b]Ian Livingstone[/b] himself and first published in 1987, this beast of a gamebook has claimed [i]many[/i] an overconfident hero. With its unforgiving traps, merciless monsters, and the utterly malevolent sorcerer [b]Razaak[/b], this is a dungeon-crawler that doesn't just test your SKILL - it tests your [i]soul[/i].[/p][quote][p]☠️ [b]Will you find the only weapon that can defeat Razaak?[/b]
🔥 [b]Can you survive the twisted lair filled with chaos and death?[/b]
💎 [b]Will you gather the enchanted relics before time runs out?[/b][/p][/quote][p]Now fully digitised and enhanced for modern adventurers, this edition includes:[/p][p]🎨 Les Edwards’ [b]original Puffin cover[/b]
🗺️ A built-in [b]mapping system[/b] to track your doomed progress
📖 A [b]‘Free Read’ mode[/b] for those who want to explore without consequence
🧾 An [b]automated Adventure Sheet[/b] that handles stats, inventory, and decisions
💡 And yes, [b]a new difficulty setting[/b] for those who want just [i]slightly[/i] less pain…[/p][p]Whether you're a diehard FF veteran or a curious newcomer with nerves of steel, [b]Crypt of the Sorcerer[/b] will push you to your limits, and maybe even past them![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/ac1c71918ca76cf28bcd52e2ef54261f2e0aa580.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: BREAKING NEWS: Crypt Re-opened
notes.content: [p][b]CHALICE, MOONSTONE HILLS[/b] – In breaking news, local authorities have confirmed that the sealed tomb of infamous necromancer Razaak has been [i]"accidentally disturbed"[/i] by an as-yet-unidentified group of amateur adventurers, gold-diggers, or possibly drunk hedge wizards.[/p][p]The fissure — described as “smelling like rotting ambition and burnt toast” — reportedly erupted with foul vapours and a skeletal hand flipping off a passing Giant Eagle. One Elf barely survived the encounter, and is now recovering at the Lion Inn on a strict diet of soup, grog, and trauma therapy.[/p][p]“It’s exactly what I warned people about,” muttered reclusive wizard and known herb enthusiast Yaztromo. “You let one idiot open a cursed sarcophagus 110 years early and boom — there goes the kingdoms.”[/p][p]The undead crisis, dubbed [i]"CryptStorm"[/i] by local media, has sparked panic-buying of healing potions, talismans, and pre-owned swords. The Allansia Weather Bureau has also issued a [b]Grim Forecast Warning[/b], with plague, pestilence, and possible spectral fog expected to blanket the western provinces “by Thursday.”[/p][p]Historians confirm Razaak was originally an apprentice of good magic, but switched majors to Evil after discovering it had better dental. His downfall came at the skeletal hands of Kull, a sword enthusiast who unknowingly wielded Razaak’s own cursed blade, and paid for the victory by being instantly reduced to dust and then turned into an unwilling ghost boat captain.[/p][p]Now, a new hero must rise. [b]Probably you.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/391e1c9a36664a52c464822f76a01971cdec242e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Keep Your Eye on the Dragon!
notes.content:
Steel your nerves and ready your dice. [i]Eye of the Dragon[/i] is coming to Fighting Fantasy Classics on April 22nd! Penned by series co-creator Ian Livingstone and originally released in 2005 during the Wizard Books revival, this legendary dungeon crawler marked a triumphant return for Fighting Fantasy in the early 2000s. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/b8aa73b76f6c7141a52d87eec7f323c73a82f515.png[/img]
[i]Eye of the Dragon[/i] invites YOU to embark on a perilous quest deep beneath Darkwood Forest in search of the fabled Golden Dragon - rumoured to be the most valuable treasure in all of Allansia. Your journey begins in a tavern in Fang, where a mysterious stranger offers you the chance of a lifetime. But beware - before you even set foot in the labyrinth, you must survive a deadly potion! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/fc981380750faede5cd4f40587982830de732ad2.png[/img]
Inside the maze, you’ll face the usual savage creatures, deadly traps, and puzzles, a staple of FF gamebooks, that will test your wit and courage. Along the way, discover maps, magical artifacts, jewels, and even an imprisoned dwarf who may just be the key to your survival. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3588900/Eye_of_the_Dragon_Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/]WISHLIST NOW![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/a2a86013d2cf57406240440c9f3c314f952c2c7a.png[/img]

notes.title: Your Fate is Written in the Stars!
notes.content:
The legendary [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] library has just expanded with the addition of [i]Starship Traveller[/i], the first-ever science-fiction gamebook in the Fighting Fantasy series. Originally written by Steve Jackson and first published in 1984, this intergalactic choice-based adventure is now available to download. After we first released this gamebook as a Standalone title 10 years ago, it's returned, re-coded from the ground up to fill in the fourth slot on your FF digital bookshelf!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3510410/Starship_Traveller_Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/
[i]
In Starship Traveller, YOU are the captain of the Starship Traveller, lost in an uncharted universe after being pulled through the terrifying Seltsian Void. Stranded far from home, you must explore alien planets, negotiate with strange civilizations, and survive deep-space battles to find the way back to Earth. Every decision you make affects your crew, your ship, and your survival—will you lead your team to victory or be lost in the void forever?[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/7fc663d617c1c0bb6ed6549383f31842e632a640.png[/img]
[b]What’s Next for [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics?[/i][/b]
The adventure doesn’t stop here! In approximately six weeks, [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] will expand once again with the release of [i]Eye of the Dragon[/i], written by Ian Livingstone. This classic dungeon-crawling fantasy adventure invites players to seek out the legendary Eye of the Dragon, a powerful gem hidden deep within a treacherous labyrinth filled with traps, monsters, and deadly challenges. Fans of traditional [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] gamebooks won’t want to miss this epic test of skill and luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/fde4d86480fe32a2d8e7b8a84cf15381a7739c03.png[/img]

Keep adventuring and may your STAMINA never fail!

[i]The Tin Man Games team [/i]

notes.title: A big-ish update coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! We have an update that we'll be pushing up in the next week or so that brings some QoL improvements to Fighting Fantasy Classics, particularly if you're playing your gamebooks on a Steam Deck.

[h3]1) New Save System[/h3]

Support has been added for three adventure profiles per FF gamebook. This means you can have multiple run-throughs with three different characters, each with 100 page saves (bookmarks) that also include the time and date of the save. We'll also be giving you the ability to delete your bookmarks too, a regularly requested feature! You'll also be able to delete an adventure profile, if you feel you've wandered too far down one of Ian or Steve's notorious story dead-ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/da8548b8a3501909cf01344da0fbae97f146e24e.jpg[/img]

[h3]2) Controller Support[/h3]

We're making full use of modern controllers, with a mind to making the game more playable on your handheld device of choice, or using controllers on your computer. For Steam Deck users this means using buttons to select buttons, roll dice and turn pages, rather than using the mousepad, which can sometimes feel a little cumbersome in FFC. Keyboard support is also included that should hopefully help us when requesting our big green Steam Deck tick!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/d12851958febb3b484ddd258f8b71fc1fe37331e.jpg[/img]

[h3]3) Updates to page layouts[/h3]

And finally, we've made some minor tweaks to the the page layouts, which should now make better use of the original gamebook page dividers - a HUGE part of an FF gamebook's aesthetic. An embossed FF logo will also replace blank, empty pages on the right, which reinforces the FF brand in screenshots, and helps add a bit more character to the presentation.

If you're an FF fan and you've been on the fence with regards to making your Steam library portable, now may be a good time! ːwarlockorcː

Coming very soon.

notes.title: Boldly going...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/0ebd3f46b0d27415047c470db1e19952f7a64aa8.png[/img]

If you love to arrange your [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] gamebooks in the original 80s [i]Puffin[/i] release order, you will no doubt be aware of the gap where book number 4 should sit. We're fixing that early next year as we bring Steve Jackson's [i]Starship Traveller[/i] to the library!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/dba71c28b014ca4def32d22ab36fcd115f968051.png[/img]

Unlike our 2015 standalone release, we've re-coded Steve's gamebook from the ground up, bringing it much closer to the original 1983 publication. Simon Lissaman's amazing visuals do make another appearance though, so if you've never seen them before, you're in for a real treat!

[i]The fate of the Starship Traveller and her crew lies in YOUR hands!

Sucked through the nightmare of the Seltsian Void, the starship Traveller emerges at the other side of the black hole into an unknown universe. YOU are the captain of the Traveller and her fate depends on YOU! Will you be able to discover the way back to Earth from the alien peoples and planets you encounter, or will the starship be doomed to roam uncharted space forever?"[/i]"

Keep an eye on the cosmos, sometime in early 2025! We're also working on two other FF releases to follow shortly after, with even more to come next year.

notes.title: FFC is coming to the Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/81c0dced4989864f08167511101ea177aecd6eac.jpg[/img]

One of the most popular requests we get is whether we can push out a "proper" build of Fighting Fantasy Classics on the Steam Deck. It's a great platform for handheld gaming, and seeing as the FF books were technically some of the very first on-the-go games for Gen Xers back in the 80s, it's a perfect fit.

We're currently adding in controller support as well as updating FFC's saving system to allow for multiple save slots per book. We're also adding in cloud saving, which is obviously super important for FF fans playing on their computer and Steam Deck. A new build will be pushed out in a couple of weeks and we'll then request deck verification from the Steam gods. 

There will also be an announcement in the next few weeks about new FF titles coming to the library! If you follow the TMG channels on X or Discord, you may already have seen a few clues! ːwarlockorcː

notes.title: Become a Superhero Sleuth in Steve Jackson's epic adventure!
notes.content:
It's time to add a new addition to the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] library! This one may be familiar to fans of our digital gamebooks in the past, as we first adapted this as a standalone title nine years ago - where has that time gone? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/24d1ef64b9fb65a91432f55296683c747d78b28d.png[/img]

This time round we've kept things more authentic to Steve Jackson's original 1985 paperback release, including all the powers and fights as they originally appeared, and maintaining the storylines to each of the four powers exactly as they flowed in the original adventure. Even though this has meant a complete re-coding of the gamebook, it's been great to revisit Titan City once again and join the wacky supervillains that are hell-bent on taking over the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/7d2d4649ae908c0ead279866b2f50ccdedeefcec.png[/img]

We have included a few extras from our standalone version though, including a number of the villain portraits that were commissioned for that game, which you can collect as you defeat each of the enemies. There are also new hero portraits to choose from and a new comic book page layout. You'll also notice we've added a new soundtrack called "Superhero Swing", which captures that 90s Saturday morning superhero cartoon vibe!

So, if superheroes are your jam and you love gamebooks, then make sure to check out Appointment with FEAR!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2081031/Appointment_with_FEAR_Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/

[i]P.S. We had a slight hiccup with our previous build due to some changes in a Unity update. If you had problems accessing your books, we're so sorry! We've now pushed out a new build that fixes that issue.[/i]

notes.title: Titan City needs a new hero!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/30ce5f419ac3b66b174dcbeff4214bbffa4dda4d.png[/img]

[i]Tough, incorruptible champion of law and order, YOU are a SUPERHERO!

Using your superpowers, you protect the innocent citizens of teeming Titan City from the terrorism, violence, kidnapping and corruption of a host of super-villains. Your mission is to discover the location of the top-secret F.E.A.R. meeting, capture the Titanium Cyborg and his cohorts, and bring them to justice.[/i]

We've had a few requests to bring Steve Jackson's [i]Appointment with FEAR[/i] over to [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i], so we've re-coded the original gamebook from the ground-up and will add it to the library by the end of the year! 

As you may already know, we developed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/316140/Appointment_With_FEAR/]another game[/url] based on the gamebook property back in 2014. While this new FFC version is strictly an almost 1-to-1 of the original paperback release, we have managed to bring across a few treats from that game. These include the addition of the original soundtrack (including the battle theme), all of the newly re-coloured artwork, and much of the supervillain artwork that was created solely for that release. We've also added a new page skin if you want the layout to have more of a comic book feel!

So grab your cape, take to the skies, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2081031/Appointment_with_FEAR_Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/]WISHLIST NOW![/url]

P.S. We're still tweaking [i]Armies of Death[/i] and will have more news on that in the new year, along with the announcement of another FFC addition. There's lots to look forward to!

[i]Can YOU defeat the nightmare army of the undead?

Agglax the Shadow Demon is amassing an army of undead warriors to conquer Allansia.

Setting off from Fang with over two hundred veteran fighters, YOU journey east to meet the enemy. But the Shadow Demon is not of this world and special powers are needed to destroy him. The longer you spend searching for these powers the stronger he will be.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/b64664b3ca34997b40cf5aeb1feb0e84d6bbe164.png[/img]

One of three incoming additions to the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] library, we're incredibly excited to announce [i]Armies of Death[/i]! In Ian Livingstone's sequel to [i]Trial of the Champions[/i] (book 38 in the old Puffin run), you must raise an army using your newly won purse of 20,000 gold pieces. The gamebook uses a new combat system to allow your troops to fight against multiple opponents, as you take the battle to Agglax, an evil Shadow Demon!

As you will have noticed from the announcement art, we're incredibly honoured to have secured the rights to use the original cover artwork by Christos Achilléos, who sadly passed away late last year. This is an iconic [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] illustration and one that many readers from 1988 will be familiar with.

Release date is yet to be decided, as we are creating new interior illustrations for the digital adaptation. We'll let you know as soon as we know more. Keep your eyes peeled for more announcements before the end of the year!

notes.title: Jim Burns' nostalgic Freeway Fighter cover licensed for FF Classics!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/042a5ec7d260fb0d2d6239e1eaeff665b782349b.png[/img]

[i]Fightasy Fantasy[/i] gamebooks have been published a number of times over the decades by different book publishers. This lead to some of the titles having new artwork commissioned in later publications by [i]Wizard Books[/i] or [i]Scholastic[/i] due to licensing constraints or simply to fit in with the times. 

When adding a new title into [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] we like to try and match the artwork as close as possible to the original 80s [i]Puffin[/i] green-spine release. This isn't always possible for a number of reasons, but we're super excited to announce that we have secured the rights to use Jim Burns' original [i]Freeway Fighter[/i] artwork! 

Many FF fans around the world will remember when the 13th Fighting Fantasy title dropped on to shop and library shelves in 1985. They were blown away by Jim's iconic cover artwork that captured a stylish [i]Mad Max[/i]-style dystopian future. 

[b][i]"A Fighting Fantasy adventure story with fighting cars!"[/i][/b]

In just a few weeks you'll be able to once again race Ian Livingstone's armour-plated Dodge Interceptor across an alternate 2022 future, as you attempt to reach San Anglo to secure vital supplies for your settlement at New Hope! You'll face-off against dune buggies, helicopters, motorbikes, and even an E-Type Jaguar. Start your engines...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/a2a86013d2cf57406240440c9f3c314f952c2c7a.png[/img]

notes.title: Is it time for a long road trip soon?
notes.content:
[i]In 2022 the world's population was virtually wiped out by a lethal germ. YOU are one of the few survivors living in the fortified town of New Hope. Outside roam the lawless new barbarians - death and destruction is their way of life.[/i]

Sound familiar? That's because it's the back cover blurb of Ian Livingstone's [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] gamebook, [i]Freeway Fighter[/i], originally published as a paperback in 1985. YOU (or at least other FF fans like you) have decided that this should be the next title to appear in the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] library!

We ran a Twitter poll through our [url=https://twitter.com/TinManGames]@TinManGames[/url] account with 117 FF fans choosing the next adventure. As you can see the results were pretty one-sided, with 54.7% of respondents gunning for Ian's post-apocalyptic Mad Max inspired adventure gamebook.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/a6745c6d4c36c093575403658137da9dbdb3fb72.png[/img]

Thankfully that was one of the titles we were working on, so expect to hop into your armour-plated Interceptor and fire off a few rockets in a few months.

Please let us know which Fighting Fantasy titles you would like to see added to the Classics library! There's been a surge of interest again since we released [i]Creature of Havoc[/i] and [i]Temple of Terror[/i], so expect to see a few more additions this year!

notes.title: UPDATE 10/02/2022: Under the Hood Loading Improvements
notes.content:
Hi there adventurers! 

For some time now we've been receiving bugs relating to book covers not appearing, bookshelves being empty and in a few cases the game not loading at all. While we've been able to fix these in most cases as they appear, they have been symptoms of a larger problem with the way we loaded books and illustration artwork. Therefore we decided to completely overhaul our book loading system, which should not only completely solve these problems, but will ensure we can more easily and cleanly add new books in the future.

As all of these changes are under the hood, you shouldn't notice any changes to your [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] experience. However as with any software development updates, despite thorough testing, new issues may arise. We're pretty sure this shouldn't be the case, but if you experience any bugs please let us know at [i]minion (at) tinmangames (dot) com (dot) au[/i] or post a new discussion thread in the forum.

May your STAMINA never fail!

[i]The Tin Man Games team[/i]

We've rolled back to a previous build that should clear up the problem but we need to look into the issue a bit more over the next week to make sure there's no additional nasties hiding in that piece of code.

Hopefully the roll back should fix most people's issues, but please do drop a message on the discussion boards if you're continuing to have problems. Sorry again!

notes.title: Steam Release Hotfixes (v33)
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Fighting Fantasy Classics and supporting our release! We hope you're enjoying the gamebooks.

[h1] Fixes [/h1]
- Added 'Stalking Danger' ambient tracks.
- Added keyboard support (Left/Right Arrows, A/D) for turning pages.
- Replaced the report a bug button on PC/OSX with a notification.
- Fixed a problem with automatically setting FPS limitations.

- Fixed a problem in The Warlock of Firetop Mountain where trying to open the chest after beating Zagor crashes the book.
- Fixed achievement unlocking in multiple books. This will only affect future playthroughs of books.
- Changed resolution naming.
- Fixed the knowledge sheet disappearing offscreen when dragged.
- The Free Choice Heal button will now totally fill your Stamina
- Fixed the Free Choice Rewind button's popup from not exiting on pressing cancel.
- Luck button will no longer appear on the first round of a battle.

notes.title: Bloodbones is FREE!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers,

There's less than 48 hours left until the release of [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i]! Before long you can return to the fabled realm of Allansia and explore the many stories it has to offer. 

The game will be a free-to-play download for all Steam users, with every player receiving one full-length gamebook for free with their download - the swashbuckling pirate adventure [i]Bloodbones[/i]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32824257/e76d507c874e0cf3055d5517e804dbfa7899bf6d.png[/img]

[i]Bloodbones[/i] sees you take on the role of a traveler seeking vengeance against the powerful Pirate Lord Cinnabar. The dread Captain raided your village and murdered your family many moons ago, and YOU have journeyed to the Port of Crabs to hunt him down and have your revenge. 

The original gamebook is notorious for being the "lost" [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] title and although it was written during the books' Puffin paperback run of the 1980s and 90s, it wasn't published until 2006 by Wizard Books. Now, [i]Bloodbones[/i] makes a triumphant return as part of our Classics library.

We’ll have seven other classic [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] gamebooks available for purchase at launch, including [i]Warlock of Firetop Mountain[/i], [i]Deathtrap Dungeon[/i] and [i]Citadel of Chaos[/i]. 

Stay tuned for more news and updates on all things [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i].

Until then, may your LUCK prosper and your STAMINA never fail!
